description:
A lightweight, developer-focused database management tool. Supports MySQL, PostgreSQL and SQLite. Hackable with plugins. Built for speed, security, and aesthetics.


📖 Read the announcement blog post: https://tabularis.dev/blog/v0250-installable-themes-aws-ssm-update-badges-mcp-toon?utm_src=github-release
See the assets below to download this version and install.
What's Changed
- feat(plugins): let the extra_fields slot hide host credential inputs by @debba in #780
- fix: open JSON viewers for read-only query results by @igorzelaya-io in #763
- feat: expose table and column comments by @debba in #764
- fix: self-heal MCP driver registry on unsupported-driver misses by @aesslinger in #784
- fix: reconcile MCP driver registry against disabled/uninstalled plugins by @aesslinger in #789
- feat(updates): add core and plugin update badges and startup toast by @debba in #786
- feat(mcp): add optional TOON tool output by @debba in #762
- chore(plugins): bump DynamoDB plugin to v0.1.7 by @fuleinist in #796
- perf: defer startup work and reduce initial JavaScript by 84% by @debba in #790
- fix(ci): build nightlies from the newest green commit and show their real version by @debba in #798
- fix: allow selecting and copying table schema text by @debba in #797
- fix(plugins): separate plugin identity and display names (#759) by @NewtTheWolf in #795
- feat(connections): connect through AWS SSM Session Manager port forwarding by @Davydhh in #766
- fix(connections): accept MongoDB replica set URIs by @debba in #740
- feat(themes): add installable theme packages by @debba in #793
- refactor: dedupe MCP driver-registry cooldown gates into a Cooldown struct by @aesslinger in #800
- feat(themes): add Tabularium schema hints and authoring CI by @debba in #803
Full Changelog: v0.24.0...v0.25.0
